title: Tables and blocks: caption, tfoot, time, data, address and marquee
blurb: A table caption that comes down as a red rubber stamp, a footer total that counts to its new value, the datetime and value attributes drawn above their elements, an <address> drawn on an envelope that seals and leaves, and a <marquee> of links drawn as a board of lit dots.
question: A caption, a tfoot, a time and a data element aren't drawable by themselves, and a marquee moves on its own. Can a canvas restyle each from the picture of its parent, and keep a moving marquee's links working?
result: Yes in Chromium 157. A caption and a tfoot have boxes inside the table's picture, and a clipped draw moves one alone; ctx.filter turns the caption red. datetime and value aren't in the picture and are drawn as canvas text. A drawable marquee raised 60 paint events a second and none after stop(), and elementFromPoint() found a moving link in 10 of 10 samples.
